newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dah Sing buys HK$578.8 mln office floors.
newsitem.headline: Dah Sing buys HK$578.8 mln office floors.

text.p: Dah Sing Financial Holdings Ltd's wholly owned banking unit Dah Sing Bank Ltd has agreed to buy offices in North Point on Hong Kong island from a third party for HK$578.83 million cash, Dah Sing said on Friday.

The property comprises four floors, covering a total gross floor area of about 83,888 square feet, in Island Place Tower in North Point. The construction of the grade A office building is expected to be completed in mid-1997, it said.
Dah Sing Financial said the purchase would reduce operating expenses in the long run by saving on office rental costs.
